stories.title: European stocks fall to three-month lows as bond yields surge
stories.summary: European stock markets closed at three-month lows. Surging bond yields hit bank stocks hard. The sell-off tracked a broader jump in yields across the region.
stories.whyItMatters: Rising yields raise bank funding costs and pressure valuations, a signal for the wider rate outlook.
whatToWatch: Further moves in European bond yields
Bank stock performance in coming sessions
questions: What is driving the yield surge?
Will the pressure spread beyond banks?

sources.title: European stocks close at three-month lows as surging bond yields hammer banks

stories.title: US 10-year yield hits highest since 2002, then pulls back; stocks and euro fall
stories.summary: The US 10-year Treasury yield touched its highest level since 2002 before easing back. Stocks and the euro fell as markets absorbed the move.
stories.whyItMatters: The 10-year yield is a benchmark for borrowing costs across the economy, so a multi-decade high shifts rate expectations everywhere.
whatToWatch: Whether the 10-year yield retests its highs
questions: What pushed the yield to a 2002-era high?
Was the pullback a one-day move or a turning point?

sources.title: Yields fall after US 10-year hits highest since 2002; stocks, euro also decline

stories.title: Wall Street dips as rising Treasury yields overshadow software gains
stories.summary: US stocks fell as rising Treasury yields outweighed gains in software shares. The move shows rate pressure spreading even into sectors posting gains.
stories.whyItMatters: When yield pressure beats out sector-specific strength, it signals the rate story is driving the broader market.
whatToWatch: Whether software stocks hold their gains
questions: Can software strength persist if yields keep rising?

stories.title: Europe stock sell-off continues as France unveils budget and inflation data weighs
stories.summary: European stocks extended their sell-off as France unveiled its budget and new inflation data added to pressure. Investors weighed both the fiscal plan and the inflation print together.
stories.whyItMatters: French fiscal policy and eurozone inflation trends shape rate expectations and bond markets across the region.
whatToWatch: Market reaction to the French budget details
questions: How will the French budget affect the country's deficit path?
Does inflation data point to further ECB action?

stories.title: Bond sell-off may trigger large portfolio shifts at quarter's end
stories.summary: Analysts say the bond sell-off could prompt outsized portfolio rebalancing as the quarter closes. Funds often adjust stock and bond holdings at quarter-end, and the current moves may amplify that.
stories.whyItMatters: Quarter-end rebalancing can cause short-term swings in both stocks and bonds, adding volatility beyond the usual drivers.
whatToWatch: Trading activity in the final days of the quarter
Any added volatility in stocks and bonds
questions: How large could the rebalancing flows be?
